en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5545 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and Husayn ibn Uthman from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who died, and some of his heirs acknowledged a debt owed by the deceased to another man.
Imam (as) said: "That acknowledgment is binding upon the share of the one who made the acknowledgment."
